name: Salt Typhoon
summary: Salt Typhoon is a PRC state-sponsored APT focused on espionage and intelligence collection, primarily targeting telecommunications infrastructure and government entities. The group achieved significant notoriety through confirmed penetration of major US telecommunications carriers. The FBI confirmed in February 2026 that Salt Typhoon threats remain active and ongoing. Along with Volt Typhoon, it represents what analysts describe as the most serious confirmed penetration of US infrastructure by a foreign adversary since at least the Cold War.

ttps.notes: Known CVEs in network appliances; basic configuration errors exploited for entry
Living-off-the-land — PowerShell used to blend into legitimate activity
Registry manipulation for persistence and defense evasion
Windows service creation for persistent access
Active log and artifact removal to hinder forensic analysis
Broad reconnaissance of target environment before targeted collection
Automated collection of communications metadata and content from telecom infrastructure

detection_opportunities: Monitor for anomalous WMIC and PowerShell execution chains on telecom infrastructure
Alert on Windows service creation by non-standard parent processes
Detect registry modifications associated with known Salt Typhoon persistence mechanisms
Monitor for bulk communication metadata access on telecom carrier infrastructure
Alert on known CVE exploitation against network appliances
Detect Demodex rootkit indicators via kernel-level monitoring
